_comment: Every generator tool is a sibling ../* checkout of an ASCS-eV fork, on the feature/asam-pipeline branch, rebased on the recorded upstream development branch with only the recorded carried_commits cherry-picked on top. An empty carried_commits is the goal state, not a defect: it says upstream has merged everything the fork was carrying, so the fork is pinned at plain upstream and commit equals upstream_base. Updating this file is a release-like action: rebase/cherry-pick, re-verify carried_commits, regenerate both standards, and review the artifact diff in the same change. See pipeline/README.md for the procedure and for what each fork's carried commits are for.

carried_commits.subject: test: reorder the model export references the sortedOutput fix affects
fix(owl): declare a data property when the value type is an enumeration
feat(owl): let a union's alternatives be its association ends only

build.fingerprint_inputs: shapechange-core/target/classes (recursively) plus every jar resolved by `mvn -pl shapechange-core dependency:build-classpath`; each file's own SHA-256, sorted by filename, concatenated as '{filename}:{hash}\n', then SHA-256 of the concatenation

owl2shacl._carried_comment: None: the fork is pinned at plain upstream. Upstream merged every contribution it was carrying - PR 7 (owl:onDataRange simple cardinality rules), PR 8 (structural datatype ranges, owl:oneOf to sh:in) and PR 9 (owl:unionOf of class expressions to sh:or), the last as commit d5e17f9. The locked commit is upstream/main's own merge commit for PR 8.

shacl_play._carried_comment: None: the fork is pinned at plain upstream. Upstream merged every contribution it was carrying - PR 344 (supply the conversion rules explicitly), PR 345 (fail on an unreadable input), PR 346 (gather sh:ignoredProperties into an RDF list), PR 347 (gather every list-valued constraint, so sh:or/sh:and/sh:xone are well-formed lists) and, with PR 347, the xls2rdf version pin that makes this jar's content fingerprint reproducible at all. The locked commit is upstream's own follow-up 'fix merge bug', which restores the assignment in Owl2Shacl.convert that the PR 346/347 merge dropped; without it the list gathering is unreachable, so it is part of what makes PR 347 effective rather than an unrelated later change.

build.fingerprint_note: the onejar's raw file SHA-256 is NOT reproducible across clean builds: the plugin embeds per-entry ZIP timestamps. Verified across three independent clean `mvn clean install` runs: three different raw file hashes, one stable content fingerprint. The content fingerprint is computed by opening the jar as a zip, taking every non-directory entry, SHA-256 of its decompressed bytes, sorted by entry name, concatenated as '{name}:{hash}\n', then SHA-256 of the concatenation. Never lock or compare the raw file hash. Maven's generated `META-INF/maven/{groupId}/{artifactId}/pom.properties` descriptors are excluded, because they carry a build timestamp rather than code: this is a onejar, so it unpacks its dependencies, and `xls2rdf-lib` is resolved from JitPack, which builds on demand - the same pinned commit `ac18090cfd` therefore yields a different artifact each time it is rebuilt. Measured on two cached builds of that commit: 163 entries each, none missing on either side, exactly one differing - `pom.properties`, and within it only '#Thu Aug 06 04:58:39 UTC 2026' against '#Fri Jul 03 16:22:50 UTC 2026', with the same version=4.0.2 and every class byte-identical. Including it made the fingerprint report when a transitive dependency was last built instead of what this jar contains, so a clean checkout could not run at all. The exclusion is matched by location and is deliberately narrow - MANIFEST.MF and pom.xml are still covered; see scripts/test_zip_content_fingerprint.py.

serialization._comment: Released Python distributions, not sibling forks. Exact versions from scripts/requirements.txt. rdflib and pyoxigraph are deliberately not moved with diffable-rdf: 0.4.0 declares floors rdflib>=6.3.2 and pyoxigraph>=0.5.4, and its own uv.lock resolves to exactly 7.6.0 and 0.5.9, so these pins are the combination it is tested against.

build_environment._maven_archive_comment: Keyed by archive filename because the two published archives of the same release have different checksums, and an unqualified value cannot say which one it verifies. On Linux you fetch the .tar.gz. Both values are Apache's published ones from archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.9/binaries/.

build_inputs._comment: Content-based fingerprints, verified identical across two independent clean `mvn clean install` rebuilds of the locked commits above, using the exact algorithm implemented in scripts/generate_semantic_artifacts.py (shapechange_runtime_fingerprint, zip_content_fingerprint). Update only after reproducing a new value across two independent clean builds in the environment recorded in build_environment. These values are environment-specific by nature: the same source compiled by JDK 21.0.11 and by 21.0.12 produces different fingerprints, which is what build_environment exists to pin. A value that will not reproduce is a defect to diagnose, not a number to overwrite - a fingerprint is only worth recording once every input it covers is itself pinned.
